_comment: PubMed seed queries for PaperFate corpus. Each entry is queried separately and its results saved to data/pubmed/<key>-<YYYY-MM-DD>.jsonl. Tune freely.

seeds.hepatology_hcc: (hepatocellular carcinoma[Title/Abstract] OR HCC[Title/Abstract]) AND (risk[Title/Abstract] OR surveillance[Title/Abstract] OR prediction[Title/Abstract])
seeds.hepatology_general: (chronic hepatitis B[Title/Abstract] OR NAFLD[Title/Abstract] OR MASLD[Title/Abstract] OR cirrhosis[Title/Abstract]) AND humans[MeSH]
seeds.glp1_obesity: (GLP-1[Title/Abstract] OR semaglutide[Title/Abstract] OR tirzepatide[Title/Abstract] OR liraglutide[Title/Abstract]) AND (obesity[Title/Abstract] OR diabetes[Title/Abstract] OR cardiovascular[Title/Abstract])
seeds.ai_clinical_models: (deep learning[Title/Abstract] OR machine learning[Title/Abstract] OR transformer[Title/Abstract] OR foundation model[Title/Abstract]) AND (clinical[Title/Abstract] OR diagnosis[Title/Abstract] OR prognosis[Title/Abstract] OR risk prediction[Title/Abstract])
seeds.external_validation: (external validation[Title/Abstract] OR multicenter[Title/Abstract] OR multi-center[Title/Abstract]) AND (prediction model[Title/Abstract] OR risk score[Title/Abstract] OR clinical model[Title/Abstract])
seeds.decision_curve: (decision curve analysis[Title/Abstract] OR net benefit[Title/Abstract] OR clinical utility[Title/Abstract])
seeds.rct_landmark: (randomized controlled trial[Publication Type] OR RCT[Title/Abstract]) AND (Lancet[Journal] OR "N Engl J Med"[Journal] OR JAMA[Journal] OR BMJ[Journal])
seeds.meta_analysis: (meta-analysis[Publication Type] OR systematic review[Publication Type]) AND humans[MeSH]
seeds.imaging_ai: (MRI[Title/Abstract] OR CT[Title/Abstract] OR ultrasound[Title/Abstract] OR radiomics[Title/Abstract]) AND (deep learning[Title/Abstract] OR AI[Title/Abstract] OR neural network[Title/Abstract])
